title: test(runtime): pay the view read's lint load at module top in meta-write-org-scope
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9V2uHgH5HekdBdXA8rYk895)_
Fixes #29603

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：只改测试。`meta-write-org-scope.test.ts` 在文件顶部预先加载 `@objectstack/lint`，runtime 的 vitest 配置把这个包根指到源码。
- 为什么改：那个 ⭐ D6 用例里的视图读取会第一次懒加载 lint 包，vitest 下冷编译要 1.2 秒（最慢 1.7 秒），全算进用例的 5 秒超时里，分片负载一高就超时变红。现在这笔开销在收集阶段付掉，用例本身降到约 20 毫秒。
- 风险与回滚：不动产品代码，不加超时，不重试，断言一条没改。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/runtime/src/meta-write-org-scope.test.ts`（顶部那条 import 和注释），`packages/runtime/vitest.config.ts`（新的 `@objectstack/lint` 别名）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --project local src/meta-write-org-scope.test.ts --reporter=verbose`，预期 20 个用例全绿，⭐ D6 用例几十毫秒（main 上约 1.2 秒）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `packages/runtime/src/meta-write-org-scope.test.ts`: a module-top `import '@objectstack/lint'`, with a comment naming the cost it moves. No case, assertion or timeout changes.
- `packages/runtime/vitest.config.ts`: one anchored alias, `^@objectstack/lint$` → `../lint/src/index.ts`, beside the existing `/runtime` entry. `check:test-source-alias` requires it for the new import (its remedy text, verbatim shape), and it is the same entry metadata-protocol's lazy import resolves through, so the view read now judges the lint rule in the checkout rather than `dist/`.

## Why

The failure on `1a95c746` (run 41514567522, Test Core 3/8, job 125515971369) was a **timeout**, not an assertion: `Error: Test timed out in 5000ms.` at `meta-write-org-scope.test.ts:419:5`; the file ran 5978 ms that run.

Where the time goes, measured by timing the case's steps in a scratch copy (deleted): `makeStack` 0 ms, the `PUT /view/…` 19 ms, the **first** `GET /view/…` 1500 ms, a second identical GET 2 ms. The first GET is the first view read in the file. A served view read decorates `_diagnostics` with the lint's form-layout warnings (`withFormLayoutWarnings`, called from `getMetaItem`'s `serveFormLayout`), and that helper imports the lint package root lazily on first use: `loadFormLayoutLint`, `packages/metadata-protocol/src/metadata-diagnostics.ts:481`. Under vitest that first import is a cold transform of the lint module graph, inside the clocked case. The sibling plural-spelling case does the same PUT but no GET, which is why it runs in 3 ms.

The lazy import is deliberate product design (the kernel boot path reaches `@objectstack/lint` only through `/runtime`), so the product code stays as it is. The fix is the repo's clocked-window rule (AGENTS.md § Build & Test; `scripts/check-test-source-alias.mjs`): pay the first load at module top, during collection, which no timeout clocks. The protocol's later `import()` gets the same module instance back (measured: the first GET drops from 1500 ms to 7 ms). `check:test-source-alias` cannot see this load on its own, because it happens in another package's code.

## Tests

Duration of the ⭐ case and the file (sum of its 20 case durations), `--maxWorkers=1`, one vitest process per run, under `os-verify-lock.sh` (shared-box seconds):

| | ⭐ case p50 / max | file total p50 / max | slowest sibling (max) |
|---|---|---|---|
| before, `2da42e74`, 20 runs | 1202 / 1740 ms | 1433 / 1939 ms | 130 ms |
| before, 4 concurrent copies on 4 cores | 1463 / 1654 ms | 1695 / 1862 ms | 62 ms |
| after, `867f4777`, 20 runs | 20 / 32 ms | 218 / 268 ms | 72 ms |
| after, 4 concurrent copies on 4 cores | 20 / 30 ms | 283 / 329 ms | 95 ms |

The case now runs at sibling speed. The load moved into collection (the run's `import` phase), which `testTimeout` does not clock.

Forced test edits: none. No assertion, timeout or case moved; the case still proves the overlay-enabled `view` lands env-wide and the read serves it.

<details><summary>Runtime suite on the final head</summary>

`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime test` (vitest project `local`) on `867f4777`, under the lock: `Test Files 528 passed (528)`, `Tests 8506 passed | 19 skipped (8525)`, VERDICT command-exit 0. The same suite on the first head `da6bf162` (preload only): 528/528, 8506 passed.

</details>

## Verification

Head `867f4777` (branch merged with `origin/main` `81cd9eb0e` before the PR).

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` on `867f4777`: 50 commands (2 paths, 19 changed lines). All 50 ran on this head, each exit 0. `--ran` reconciliation: `50 derived, 50 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`.
- On the first head, `check:test-source-alias` was red (`NEW unaliased artifact import(s) … @objectstack/lint`); the alias in `vitest.config.ts` is its remedy, green on this head (`120 packages with tests scanned`).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck`: exit 0 (`check:test-typecheck: OK`, debt ledger held).
- Lint: root eslint over `packages/runtime` with `--no-inline-config` (the package has no lint script): exit 0.
- No ablation: the diff changes no tested behaviour. The before/after table above is the reverse reading: without the preload the case pays the 1.2 s load, with it 20 ms.
- Dogfood: n/a (no `!`, no `(narrowing)` arm).
- CI check-runs: not read yet; the seat reads them at ACCEPT.
